findings: Identidad/version: 〜間に; SHA-256 de articleMarkdown 2ce6dfe4934f6107d4fe5022818f958927794dc48d0ade42f5196565f410ea14; la fila wiki_articles y generatedAt 2026-09-20T00:27:08.201Z coinciden con el JSON canónico local. La coincidencia confirma identidad, no exactitud semántica.

The distinction between 間に (event within interval) and 間 (state/action spanning interval) is presented clearly, but no authoritative Japanese grammar locator was obtained to support the temporal-aspect rule.
The article states that the situation before 間に lasts during the interval; whether all verb forms and nouns behave this way needs qualification and paradigm evidence.
授業の間に, 日本にいる間に, 留守の間に and 若い間に examples plus Spanish tense/aspect glosses were not checked against corpus.
The contrast 会議の間 versus 会議の間に illustrates the point but remains editorially authored.

No consulted Japanese source supports the temporal-aspect contrast between 間に and 間 or the article’s state-duration generalization. The article’s created examples have not been checked against primary exemplars/corpus.
